rationale: First, partial-but-usable core map for the hashicorp/raft snapshot (module github.com/hashicorp/raft, commit c0dc6a0b). The submission records the two core relationships required by the activity roles and, crucially, their connection, from read code plus the membership design document: (A1) qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement, realized as pre-vote campaign -> real vote campaign -> per-term vote grants -> leader no-op + replication -> quorum commitment at or above the first index of the leader's term; and (A2) context validity and acquisition/transfer/loss of authority, realized as the durable current term plus per-term vote, step-down-and-bump on newer terms, and leadership transfer via TimeoutNow with the candidateFromLeadershipTransfer exemption. The connection is sourced: formation eligibility and the commitment quorum are read from the latest configuration; configuration changes are only opened once latest==committed and the leader has committed an entry of its own term (configurationChangeChIfStable), which is why a no-op is always dispatched on election; and old work is bounded by present authority (votes honoured only for their own term, an AppendEntries reply reporting a newer term driving handleStaleTerm/step-down, conflicting-suffix truncation rolling latest back to committed, and inflight futures failed with ErrLeadershipLost on step-down). Residual local anomalies are recorded under core_overview.open_details rather than blocking the overview: the appendEntries StoreLogs-failure TODO leaving lastLog stale (raft.go:1541), electSelf returning a nil response channel on self-vote persistence failure (raft.go:2023), and checkLeaderLease assuming a replState entry exists for every latest-config voter (raft.go:1054). Several high-consequence paths remain explicitly unmapped surfaces (installSnapshot body, leader-side snapshot shipping, runFSM, snapshot lifecycle), and the next step is to read them and pick a sourced discriminator rather than to treat this map as coverage. No obligation or check is claimed here.
